domains.name: Cognition and subjective state
domains.why_space: Shows performance and feeling side by side to support the follow-up plan and review requests.
domains.limits_note: No psychological diagnosis from a game or a pulse. The self-rating and Decode are different scales and are never combined.
domains.how_to_measure: Daily check: rate alertness 1-10, log mood, then play one 90-second Decode round.
domains.when_to_involve_specialist: When a follow-up asks for a review, or any time you want one: use Request help.
domains.risk: Risk of Behavioral Changes and Psychiatric Disorders

domains.name: Sleep and daily rhythm
domains.why_space: Separates recorded sleep from the rest opportunity, follows the plan and reviews schedule conflicts and alternatives.
domains.limits_note: Recorded sleep is a wrist estimate. Less sleep and lower performance happening together is not proof of a cause.
domains.how_to_measure: Imported each morning from the wrist sensor, with its source.
domains.when_to_involve_specialist: When short sleep continues despite plan steps, or you want help with the schedule.
domains.risk: Risk from Inadequate Sleep and Irregular Schedules

domains.name: Heart and circulation
domains.why_space: Follows the measurement plan, shows trends and requests a review when needed.
domains.limits_note: Pulse alone does not assess heart health.
domains.how_to_measure: Seated, at rest, with the wrist sensor in firm contact.
domains.when_to_involve_specialist: When the plan's review condition is met, or with any symptom.

domains.name: Symptoms and temperature
domains.why_space: Keeps the sequence of symptoms, completes missing information and supports specialist follow-up.
domains.limits_note: Temperature is not an immunity score. Skin temperature is not core body temperature.
domains.how_to_measure: Use Report something at any time; no medical category needed.
domains.when_to_involve_specialist: Any symptom can be sent for review. The urgent path never waits for a game result.

domains.name: Nutrition and hydration
domains.why_space: Follows the specialist's targets and avoids duplicate entry.
domains.limits_note: A consumption log does not prove deficiency or dehydration.
domains.when_to_involve_specialist: As set by the mission's nutrition plan.

domains.name: Movement and exercise
domains.why_space: Tracks execution of the exercise plan and reasons for missed sessions.
domains.limits_note: Completing exercise does not measure bone density. Step count is not evidence of bone health.
domains.when_to_involve_specialist: Pain during exercise, or sessions repeatedly missed.

domains.name: Radiation exposure
domains.why_space: Exposure log and review by an approved protocol.
domains.limits_note: Solar activity alone does not give a personal dose.
domains.when_to_involve_specialist: As set by the approved exposure protocol.
